newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT-Telebras 1997 price target raised.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT-Telebras 1997 price target raised.

text.p: -- Bear Stearns said in a report it had increased its 1997 year-end price target for Brazilian telecom firm Telebras to $135/ADS from $115/ADS, suggesting a 21 percent upside potential from current levels.
-- It also said it was maintaining its buy rating on the stock.

-- They also increased their full-year 1997 earnings estimates to $9.70/ADS from $9.30/ADS and their 1998 earnings forecast to $12.30/ADS from $11.85/ADS, "implying year-on-year earnings growth of 17 percent and 27 percent in 1997 and 1998, respectively."
-- Telebras ADRs were four points up at $112.75.
